title: Industry-ready
subtitle: Master in-demand tech skills with real-world projects and land your dream job

courses.title: Web Development
courses.tagline: Build responsive & dynamic websites from scratch
courses.description: Web Development is the skill of creating websites and web applications that people use every day — from college websites and online shops to booking portals. In this course you start from the very basics (how a web page is made) and move step-by-step to building complete, live websites with a real database behind them.
courses.easyExplanation: Think of a website like a house. HTML is the structure (walls & rooms), CSS is the paint & interior design, JavaScript is the electricity that makes things work, and Node.js is the water tank & wiring hidden behind the walls that supplies everything.

syllabus.title: Web Fundamentals
syllabus.description: How the internet works, browsers, domains, hosting, client vs server

syllabus.title: HTML5
syllabus.description: Page structure, text, links, images, tables, forms, semantic tags

syllabus.title: CSS3 & Responsive Design
syllabus.description: Colours, fonts, Box Model, Flexbox, Grid, media queries, animations

syllabus.title: Bootstrap
syllabus.description: Grid system, ready components, building mobile-friendly layouts fast

syllabus.title: JavaScript
syllabus.description: Variables, loops, functions, DOM, events, ES6+, fetch & APIs

syllabus.title: React.js
syllabus.description: Components, props, state, hooks, routing, building single-page apps

syllabus.title: Node.js & Database
syllabus.description: Server basics, Express, REST APIs, MongoDB / MySQL connection

syllabus.title: Git, Hosting & Deployment
syllabus.description: Git & GitHub, domain setup, deploying a live website

courses.whoShouldJoin: B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc (IT/CS) students, 12th-pass students & anyone who wants to build websites.

courses.title: App Development
courses.tagline: Learn modern tools & technologies to build powerful mobile applications
courses.description: Every business today wants its own mobile app. In this course you learn to design and build Android & iOS apps using modern cross-platform technology — one code, two platforms. You will build apps with login, lists, maps, notifications and online data, and learn how apps are published on the Play Store.
courses.easyExplanation: A mobile app is like a shop in your pocket. The screens you see are the shop counter, the logic is the shopkeeper who takes your order, and the backend / Firebase is the godown where all the stock (data) is safely kept.

syllabus.title: App Basics & Setup
syllabus.description: How mobile apps work, Android vs iOS, native vs cross-platform, tool setup

syllabus.title: Programming Foundation
syllabus.description: JavaScript / Dart essentials — variables, functions, OOP concepts

syllabus.title: UI Design for Mobile
syllabus.description: Layouts, widgets / components, styling, themes, responsive screens

syllabus.title: Navigation & State
syllabus.description: Multi-screen apps, passing data, state management basics

syllabus.title: APIs & Networking
syllabus.description: Fetching live data from internet, JSON, displaying lists

syllabus.title: Firebase & Storage
syllabus.description: User login / signup, cloud database, local storage, push notifications

syllabus.title: Device Features
syllabus.description: Camera, gallery, location & maps, permissions

syllabus.title: Testing & Publishing
syllabus.description: Debugging, building APK / App Bundle, Play Store publishing process

projects: News / weather app using live API
Chat or food-ordering app with Firebase
Final app ready for Play Store
courses.whoShouldJoin: B.Tech, BCA, MCA, M.Tech students & developers who want to move into mobile app development.

courses.title: Digital Marketing
courses.tagline: Grow brands. Reach audiences. Get results.
courses.description: Digital Marketing is how businesses find customers online — through Google, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and email. This course teaches you how to bring a website to the top of Google, run paid ads, grow social media pages and measure results. It is ideal for both tech and non-tech students, and also for business owners.
courses.easyExplanation: Imagine you open a new shop. SEO is getting your shop onto the main road so people naturally walk in, Google / Meta Ads are paid hoardings, Social Media is word-of-mouth, and Analytics is the register that tells you who came and who bought.

syllabus.title: Marketing Fundamentals
syllabus.description: Digital vs traditional marketing, customer journey, funnels

syllabus.title: Website & WordPress Basics
syllabus.description: Creating a simple business website / landing page

syllabus.title: SEO
syllabus.description: Keyword research, on-page & off-page SEO, technical SEO, local SEO

syllabus.title: Social Media Marketing
syllabus.description: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube — content & growth strategy

syllabus.title: Google Ads
syllabus.description: Search, display & YouTube ads, bidding, budget, conversion tracking

syllabus.title: Meta Ads
syllabus.description: Facebook & Instagram ads, audience targeting, lead generation

syllabus.title: Content & Email Marketing
syllabus.description: Copywriting, blogs, Canva creatives, email campaigns

syllabus.title: Analytics & Reporting
syllabus.description: Google Analytics, Search Console, reports, ROI measurement

projects: SEO audit of a real website
Social media calendar for a brand
Live Google / Meta ad campaign (demo budget)
courses.whoShouldJoin: Any graduate or student — B.Tech, BCA, BBA, B.Com, MBA — business owners & freelancers.

courses.title: Python Programming
courses.tagline: Learn Python from basics to advanced & build real-world projects
courses.description: Python is the world's most popular and easiest programming language to start with. It is used in web development, data analysis, AI / Machine Learning, automation and much more. This course builds a strong programming foundation — logic building, problem solving and object-oriented thinking — which helps in college exams, placements and interviews.
courses.easyExplanation: Python is like simple English for computers. Instead of writing long, complex code, you write short, readable instructions — like giving clear directions to a friend. That is why it is the first language most companies and colleges recommend.

syllabus.title: Python Basics
syllabus.description: Installation, variables, data types, input/output, operators

syllabus.title: Control Flow
syllabus.description: If-else, loops, break / continue, pattern & logic-building programs

syllabus.title: Data Structures
syllabus.description: Strings, lists, tuples, sets, dictionaries & their methods

syllabus.title: Functions & Modules
syllabus.description: User-defined functions, lambda, recursion, packages, pip

syllabus.title: OOP in Python
syllabus.description: Classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation

syllabus.title: File & Error Handling
syllabus.description: Reading / writing files, CSV, JSON, exceptions

syllabus.title: Advanced Python
syllabus.description: Iterators, generators, decorators, regex, working with APIs

syllabus.title: Libraries & Next Steps
syllabus.description: Intro to NumPy, Pandas, Flask / Django, automation scripts

projects: Mini project with Flask or data analysis
careers: Foundation for Data Science / AI roles
courses.whoShouldJoin: Best first course for B.Tech (all branches), BCA, MCA, M.Tech & B.Sc students — no coding background needed.

courses.title: Frontend Technologies
courses.description: Frontend is everything a user sees and clicks on a website or web app — buttons, menus, forms, animations and layouts. This course focuses deeply on creating attractive, fast and mobile-friendly user interfaces, and ends with React, the most in-demand frontend library in the job market today.
courses.easyExplanation: If a website is a car, the frontend is the body, dashboard, seats and steering — everything the driver sees and touches. A good frontend developer makes the car look beautiful and feel easy to drive.

syllabus.title: HTML5 In-Depth
syllabus.description: Semantic structure, forms, media, accessibility basics, SEO-friendly markup

syllabus.title: CSS3 Mastery
syllabus.description: Selectors, Flexbox, Grid, positioning, transitions & animations

syllabus.title: Responsive Web Design
syllabus.description: Mobile-first approach, media queries, testing on all devices

syllabus.title: Bootstrap 5
syllabus.description: Grid, navbar, cards, modals, forms — rapid professional layouts

syllabus.title: JavaScript for UI
syllabus.description: DOM manipulation, events, form validation, sliders, ES6+

syllabus.title: React.js
syllabus.description: JSX, components, props, state, hooks, React Router

syllabus.title: APIs & UI Integration
syllabus.description: Fetching data, loading states, dynamic lists & search

syllabus.title: UI/UX Basics & Deployment
syllabus.description: Design principles, Figma to code, Netlify / Vercel hosting

projects: Movie or product search app in React
courses.whoShouldJoin: Students with creative interest — B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc, Diploma & design-minded learners.

courses.title: Backend Technologies
courses.tagline: Build robust APIs & scalable server-side applications
courses.description: Backend is the hidden engine of every application — it handles login, payments, data storage and business logic. This course teaches you to build secure servers and REST APIs using Node.js and Express.js, connect databases, and deploy applications to the cloud, just like real software companies do.
courses.easyExplanation: In a restaurant, the frontend is the dining area and menu. The backend is the kitchen: it receives your order (request), prepares it using ingredients from the store (database), and sends the dish back (response). The API is the waiter carrying orders between the two.

syllabus.title: Backend Fundamentals
syllabus.description: Client-server model, HTTP, request / response, JSON, REST

syllabus.title: Node.js Core
syllabus.description: Modules, npm, file system, events, asynchronous programming

syllabus.title: Express.js
syllabus.description: Routing, middleware, controllers, MVC project structure

syllabus.title: Databases
syllabus.description: MongoDB with Mongoose, MySQL basics, CRUD operations, relations

syllabus.title: Authentication & Security
syllabus.description: Signup / login, JWT, password hashing, roles, validation

syllabus.title: Advanced APIs
syllabus.description: File uploads, pagination, email, payment gateway integration (intro)

syllabus.title: Testing & Tools
syllabus.description: Postman, error handling, logging, environment variables

syllabus.title: Deployment
syllabus.description: Git, cloud hosting (Render / AWS basics), connecting frontend

courses.whoShouldJoin: Students who know basic programming — B.Tech, BCA, MCA, M.Tech & frontend learners moving ahead.

courses.title: Full Stack Developer
courses.tagline: Master both frontend & backend and become a complete developer
courses.description: Full Stack Development is our most complete, job-oriented program. You learn the entire journey of building an application — design, frontend, backend, database and deployment — using the popular MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node). By the end, you can build and launch a complete product on your own, which is exactly what start-ups and IT companies look for.
courses.easyExplanation: A full stack developer is like a building contractor who can handle everything — the design, the construction, the plumbing and the handover. Companies value such developers because one person can take a project from idea to launch.

syllabus.title: Web Foundations
syllabus.description: HTML5, CSS3, Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, Bootstrap

syllabus.title: JavaScript Deep Dive
syllabus.description: Core JS, ES6+, DOM, async/await, APIs, problem solving

syllabus.title: React.js

syllabus.title: Node.js & Express.js
syllabus.description: Server setup, REST APIs, middleware, MVC architecture

syllabus.title: MongoDB & SQL

syllabus.title: Auth & Security
syllabus.description: JWT, protected routes, role-based access, best practices

syllabus.title: Git, Deployment & DevOps Basics
syllabus.description: GitHub, CI basics, hosting frontend & backend, domains

syllabus.title: Capstone & Interview Prep
syllabus.description: Full product build, DSA basics, mock interviews, resume

projects: Job portal or social media app

courses.title: Data Analyst
courses.tagline: Turn data into insights & drive smart decisions
courses.description: Every company collects huge amounts of data — sales, customers, website visits. A Data Analyst cleans this data, finds patterns and presents clear reports that help managers take better decisions. This course covers Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI — the exact toolkit asked for in data analyst job descriptions.
courses.easyExplanation: A data analyst is like a detective. The data is the pile of clues, Excel & SQL help you collect and sort the clues, Python helps you investigate, and Power BI dashboards are the final report you present to solve the case.

syllabus.title: Data Analytics Basics
syllabus.description: Types of data, analytics life-cycle, roles in the data field

syllabus.title: Advanced Excel
syllabus.description: Formulas, lookups, pivot tables, charts, dashboards

syllabus.title: Statistics for Analysis
syllabus.description: Mean, median, variance, probability, correlation, sampling

syllabus.title: SQL
syllabus.description: Queries, filters, joins, group by, sub-queries, window functions

syllabus.title: Python for Data
syllabus.description: NumPy, Pandas — data collection, cleaning & transformation

syllabus.title: Data Visualization
syllabus.description: Matplotlib, Seaborn — charts that tell a story

syllabus.title: Power BI / Tableau
syllabus.description: Data modelling, DAX basics, interactive dashboards

syllabus.title: Case Studies & Capstone
syllabus.description: Real business datasets, insights report, presentation skills

projects: SQL analysis of an e-commerce database
